summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest 18/18) and frontend (Playwright E2E) testing of Remix: Srdce pro Michaelku. All backend endpoints (health, pair create/join/get, messages CRUD, photos CRUD with image validation, events CRUD across 3 types, places CRUD, AI poem/quote/message via Emergent LLM key with real Czech diacritics check) passed. Frontend onboarding, dashboard counter (54 days), 7-tab bottom navigation, messages send/list, gallery upload, calendar add-event, settings pair-code/theme/copy/unpair, AI Poet generating real Czech poetry (verified: 'Michaelko, večer tě hledám...'), and Love Map (Leaflet OpenStreetMap rendering Prague + pick mode toggle) all working.
critical_code_review_comments: Photos stored as base64 data URLs directly in MongoDB — acceptable for personal-scale app per code comment, but watch document size if many large images are uploaded (MongoDB 16MB document limit).
AI endpoints have no rate limiting and call Emergent LLM synchronously per request — could become expensive if abused; consider basic in-memory throttling per pair_id.
messages_delete returns 200 with deleted=0 when id doesn't exist (no 404). Minor inconsistency vs. messages_patch which returns 404. Same pattern for photos/events/places. Non-blocking.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; browsers ignore credentials in that combo. Fine for this anonymous app.
AI quote splitlines()[0] strips multi-line — works but consider trimming trailing punctuation too.
Frontend localStorage keys (remix.token/pair/role) properly used; no secrets exposed.
test_credentials: No credentials required — app is anonymous, uses pair codes only.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed pairs/messages/photos/events/places at runtime; ephemeral test data lives in MongoDB after run (no cleanup script — by design, small scale).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 18 endpoints incl. AI (uses real Emergent LLM key, ~15s total). For frontend: localStorage key 'remix.token' gates the onboarding screen. To skip onboarding in tests, POST /api/pair/create and seed localStorage with remix.token=owner_token, remix.pair=JSON, remix.role='owner'. Mobile viewport 430x900 recommended (app uses max-w-[480px]). AI poem generation takes 5-30s — use generous timeouts. Initial Playwright run had a flaky pass-through where rapid tab switching after a message send caused subsequent tabs to appear blank; isolating each flow with proper waits resolved this — likely a routing/state race not a real bug.
